full_page.content:
C. 1948
The following are faithful transcriptions of photocopies of handwritten messages to his brother James' family by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
1. On a Seraphic Mass Association Card:
Mrs. James Casey - for speedy health improvement, God willing - emergency - special - member.
February 18th 1948
God bless you Sister, Emma Casey
"Courage is half the battle" Keep it up.
Confidence in God is courage infinitely reinforced by God's grace to be always fostered - the very soul of prayer. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
2. On a Seraphic Mass Association Card:
V. Sister Mary Aurelia Ann - for God's holy guidance July 8th 1947 - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
3. To Sister M. Aurelia Ann:
God made me to know him O what a Bless'd aim! To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same.
It's Heaven begun For the grateful on earth To treasure aright ! ? ! Highest Heaven its worth. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Originals in possession of: Mrs. Aurelia Herkenrath 1019 108th Ave., N/E. Apt. 117 Bellevue, Wash., 98004
